transformation.kind: Presentation metadata revised; quantitative observations and source payloads unchanged. See publication notes.

limits: The collector status evidence_mapped_with_limits and historical overall acceptance incomplete are preserved as historical facts, not current release verdicts.
41phase rows have17distinct labels; they are separate operations/worker scopes, not41comparable repetitions or per-phase percentiles.
Original macOS native time maxima and non-atomic directory samples retain their boundaries; no physical IO bytes, energy, strict simultaneous disk peak or per-query CPU attribution is inferred.
The largefile original_bytes/hash and verification outputs are historical evidence bindings. The2GiBfile itself is not copied or reopened by this projection.
Killed compaction workers and successful post-kill verification/recovery observations remain separate; exit/signals/not_run fields are not normalized into success.
Original source/binary hashes identify each historical run; later names/docs/test overlays do not turn old timings into new-binary measurements.

Private path aliases are archive locators, not runnable local paths. All110original bound small artifacts were checked against collector hashes;3internal sidecar contents are omitted with hashes retained.
